notes.title: Version 1.01 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where you can not complete a quest even if you have collected all six of the six food items in the broker's quest.
- Fixed bugs where achievements are only applied at the end of the game
- Fix hunger gauge to lighter yellow color

Also, I have posted a lot of comments on the current feedback, so if you are interested please refer to it.
 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/658660/discussions/0/2906376154318662947/

Dev Arc
